nativeEvidence.query: Actual MMapManager per-instance1024-node query; native PathGenerator.h limits74 polygons/74 corners extracted at test time; native low nearest-poly extents3/5/3. No enlarged budget, forced destination or straight-line fallback.
nativeEvidence.validation: Every ordered distinct pair requires successful findPath with no status detail flags and the actual destination polygon. findStraightPath must also be complete with END at the projected destination. Every polygon must be ground/water only. Partial, exhausted, truncated and failed queries are rejected by the test; the status helper's negative cases execute separately.

results.groundOnlyBoundary: A ground-only failed search is not proof of a missing tile or disconnected topology:60 diagnostic searches exhaust the ordinary node budget. One shoreline Seirdr1563321 has no ground-only start within the low search box but has a valid nearby water start. All552 ground/water searches finish without exhaustion/truncation/partial status. Some successful water routes can have a longer ground-only alternative;367 is not a count of routes requiring water.
